messages:
anya: Heads-up: cert-manager CVE (CVE-2026-1458) popped up in the feed. Looks like a path traversal issue when parsing webhook certs. Can we triage impact on our clusters?

matt: I can take the cert-manager triage. Quick q: which clusters run cert-manager v1.10 vs v1.9?

kevin: prod, staging, and our EU-dedicated all on v1.9. nonprod mostly on v1.10.

julia: kubelet has a separate advisory (CVE-2026-2041) about kubelet auth token caching — higher severity for older nodes. We should prioritize node pool upgrades for the older GKE pools.

anya: Ok, prioritize: 1) cert-manager on prod eu (upgrade to patched v1.10.3) 2) kubelet on legacy node pools (upgrade OS + kubelet) 3) ingress-nginx minor fix for RCE vectors.

matt: For cert-manager upgrade, recommend helm upgrade flow with canary namespace first:```\nhelm repo update jetstack\nhelm upgrade cert-manager jetstack/cert-manager --namespace cert-manager --version v1.10.3 --reuse-values\n```

matt: After canary passes, rollout to remaining clusters with the same helm args. Watch Issuer and Certificate resources (they sometimes hit webhook timeouts).

kevin: KMS question: etcd snapshot encryption uses customer KMS key. If we rotate key in KMS, do we need to re-encrypt snapshots? IIRC GCP KMS has automatic key versioning but we should validate restore path.

julia: Correct — rotating key requires either re-encrypting existing snapshots or keeping the old key version in IAM for restores. For now, don't rotate master key until after we verify restore flow to new key version. I'll open a runbook step.

anya: Also need RBAC check: cert-manager upgrade changes the serviceaccount names in chart values for the webhook. Make sure the new SA still has ability to get/list/secrets where we rely on it for ACME issuers.

kevin: I'll run a dry RBAC diff via `rbac-tool diff --from v1.9 --to v1.10` against prod manifests and report back.

oncall-bot: @anya, prod incident policy triggered for cluster-upgrade window tomorrow 02:00 UTC (maintenance). Please confirm approval if we want the kubelet upgrades during that slot.

anya: Approve upgrade window for kubelet + cert-manager canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Matt, coordinate canary. Kevin, hold off KMS key rotation until backup restore test passes.

matt: Will do. I'll run canary in staging tonight and post rollout notes. Expected impacts: 30s webhook restarts, no downtime for services.

kevin: I'll spin a test restore from encrypted snapshot to a temp project with rotated key version to validate. ETA 6h.

julia: For audit logging: add this to immediate actions — increase retention of auth-related logs for the next 30 days and add a filter for cert-manager webhook failures so we can quickly spot regressions.

anya: Good call. Security-bot, can you create the alert?

security-bot: Created alert "cert-manager-webhook-errors" -> slack: #eng-security, severity: warning, window: 5m, threshold: 5 errors. URL: https://monitoring.example.com/alerts/CM-WEBHOOK-2026

matt: I'll paste canary results once done. Thanks all.

anya: Summary actions: [matt] canary + rollout, [kevin] restore test for KMS rotation, [julia] RBAC & audit rule tasks, [anya] approve maintenance. We'll reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
